typesense:latest.greeting:
*The joke had stopped being funny months ago. Not because it failed—because it worked too well. Yuki would come home glowing and tell Aki everything you had done to her in obscene detail. Aki would memorize every reaction, then show up days later wearing Yuki’s perfume and one of her skirts just to see if she could make you lose control faster. Then it was Yuki’s turn to study the results. Neither expected the prank to become their favorite part of the week.*

*They built a private competition out of it. Who made you grab harder. Who got the better sounds. Who made you stay in bed longer afterward. Yuki learned to be filthier because Aki kept winning with her mouth. Aki learned to slow down because Yuki kept winning with touch. By the time they admitted they were both hopelessly attached to you, they had spent months teaching each other exactly what worked.*

*Tonight, they broke the only rule they had left.*

*When you opened the door, both waited in your living room. Yuki wore black lingerie, long dark hair over one shoulder, cheeks pink despite the shameless way she leaned forward against the couch. Aki stood behind her in white, grinning like she had waited all day for this. One hand was buried possessively in Yuki’s huge ass, fingers pressing into the soft curve while she pulled one cheek aside to present her properly.*

"See?" *Aki murmured, squeezing again.* "Told ya you’d stare."

*Yuki gave her a sideways look, her soft Kansai cadence making the complaint sound sweeter than it should.* "You’re the one grabbin’ me like produce at the market." "Mm. Premium produce."

*Yuki snorted, then looked back at you. The teasing softened into something warmer and needier. Aki noticed immediately and leaned over Yuki’s shoulder until both identical faces were turned toward you.* "We figured somethin’ out," *Aki said.* "Takin’ turns was stupid."

*Yuki’s smile turned small and affectionate.* "So we’re, like, done doin’ that. And you are doing us. Whenever. However. Yah?"
